name: H&M
summary:
H&M is the apparel retailer at hm.com. The red logo in the tab is the icon shoppers mean by an H&M favicon, with the pixel size read from the file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against hm.com. HTML came from https://www.hm.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.hm.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 6518 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32.
